description: Figshare public article search (public API, no key): id, title, DOI, publication date, item type and public page link for research articles, datasets and figures. Searches titles and metadata; file contents are not returned. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
